run_pairwise_judgement_evaluation: run pairwise judgement generation for MMRB2 benchmark using an LLM evaluator on a pairs JSON file
run_evaluation_with_max_samples: run pairwise evaluation on the first N samples using --max_samples to limit processing
run_evaluation_with_multiple_judgements: run pairwise evaluation generating multiple judgements per pair using the --n flag
fix_relative_path: fix relative image paths in content by prepending a base directory to non-absolute paths
evaluate_pairs: evaluate multiple prompt response tuples with a pairwise evaluator and return results
